params_schema.description:
data.caption_vlm: a catalog VLM (wired model input) writes the target text of each image (research 2026-10-13).

The caption is UNTRUSTED text (security §B3): bounded by max_new_tokens, never rendered as HTML/Markdown. Greedy
decoding only (no sampling knob). The model + revision go into the dataset metadata (its licence carries over).
params_schema.title: CaptionParams

params_schema.description:
train.grpo_vlm (P020): a LoRA adapter trained with GRPO and one of the engine's BUILT-IN rewards (security §B2).

The reward compares each generated answer with the record's ``target``. Total reward = format_weight x shape
bonus + correctness_weight x score; defaults follow the engine's geometry3k example (0.1 / 0.9), confirmed by
research when the NeMo-RL probe runs.
params_schema.title: GrpoParams
